profile.headline: Senior Java Full Stack Developer
profile.summary:
•	Result-driven and quick-learner software engineer and JAVA full stack developer with experience developing robust code and testing for high-volume business in the full software development lifecycle with proficiency in the latest technologies.
•	Excellent design, development, analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and Presentation skills
•	A deep creative thinker and enthusiastic team player with phenomenal time management skills.

positions.title: Senior Java Full Stack Developer
positions.description: New York State DMV is population wise one of the largest DMV in North America region. The  Customer base is more than 12 million drivers and 11 million plus registered vehicles. NYSDMV does have 65  active locations statewide. Complex system design which involves all the state to state and AAMVA Interfaces. Part  of the ROADS modernization project in the same.

positions.title: Senior Java Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Worked on a project which is based on a tax adjustment Implementation System named GETAR with multiple company tax adjustment Rules involved.

positions.title: Java Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Worked on a project which is mainly based on local server Java Applications web hosting. Providing     Application access over remote systems and maintaining a database for it.
